quests.title: Plant Research: Twinleaf Pitcher Plants

dialogue.sit: Linnea quickly makes the necessary preparations for the investigation...

dialogue.t: You silly cat... where did you wander off to...?
Let's keep looking around.

dialogue.sit: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogue.t: Excuse me, have you seen a tiger-striped cat around here by any chance?
A tiger-striped cat? Hmm, I don't think so... Lumi, did you notice one?
Ya-ho?
Looks like Lumi hasn't seen it either. Did your cat go missing? I can help you look for it! I know this area pretty well.
Hey, Jukka! We don't have the spare money to hire an adventurer. And besides, it's just a silly cat. Let it end up wherever it wants!
Don't say that, Marja. It'd be sad if it heard you.
As if it could hear us! If it could, it would've come to us by now — we've been shouting for ages.
No need to pay me a commission for that. I was going to check out the area anyway, so I'll keep an eye out while I'm at it. Let's go, Lumi!
(There was nothing here not long ago, and now there are so many Twinleaf Pitcher Plants growing.)
(Maybe some animal brought the seeds here, but I can't just let them spread like this...)
(There was nothing here not long ago, and now there are so many Twinleaf Pitcher Plants growing.)
(Maybe some animal brought the seeds here, but I can't just let them spread like this...)
Lumi, do you think it's here too?
Ya-hoho!
So you're the one they've been looking for, huh? Hmm... doesn't look like you've got any injuries. But if we'd found you any later... who knows what could've happened.
Anyway, let's get you back to your friends first!
It's not here...
There's nothing there...
Hey! You silly cat! Can you hear me!? If you can, come out right now!
If you don't, we're leaving without you!
It's not here either...
Silly cat... where on earth are you— Oh! You found it!
It got trapped in those Twinleaf Pitcher Plants over there. They're plants, yes, but they're carnivorous, and can digest Moonglow Fireflies in just a few days...
Good thing we found it in time. It's just a little weak now, but if we'd been any later... who knows what might've happened.
G—Goodness... That's dangerous...
Hmph, can't blame anyone but yourself for crawling in there, silly cat.
Well, it's not really the cat's fault. These Twinleaf Pitcher Plants give off a special scent. Humans aren't affected, but insects and other little creatures might get drawn in.
That's how the plants catch their prey. There's an unusual number of pitcher plants here, small animals are affected by their presence too.
Oh... I see. Anyway, having this many of these plants grow here is definitely not a good sign, right?
That's right. If we leave them alone, they could cause some real trouble...
Alright, then we'll handle the weeding. Jukka, come help too!
These plants made our silly cat suffer so much. We have to return the favor.

dialogue.sit: With the help of the two treasure hunters, the unusual overgrowth of Twinleaf Pitcher Plants in the area is finally cleared...

dialogue.t: Phew... we're finally done. Time to head back to Nasha Town. Thanks a lot, miss, for helping us find this silly cat. If it weren't for your help, who knows how long it would've been trapped.
Come to think of it, Marja, if you hadn't yelled so loudly earlier, we might have found it even sooner...
Wh—What are you talking about? Anyway, the important thing is it's safe now.
(Though she calls it "silly cat" all the time, she really does care about her companion, hehe.)
That's right. The important thing is it's safe. It's dangerous out here in the wilderness, so you guys have to be careful, too.
Thank you. We will.
And good luck with your investigation. Goodbye!

quests.description: A large patch of Twinleaf Pitcher Plants has suddenly appeared somewhere on Lempo Isle…
